G2700.def:
κατα-τοξεύω 
[in LXX: Exode 19:13 (יָרָה), al. ;] 
to strike down with an arrow, shoot dead: Hébreux 12:20 (LXX) (Rec.; WH, R, om.).†

G2701.def:
κατα-τρέχω 
[in LXX: Lévitique 26:37, Juges 1:6 (רָדַף), al. ;] 
to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Actes 21:32.†

G2702.def:
κατα-φέρω 
[in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;] 
to bring down: αἰτιώματα, Actes 25:7; ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, Actes 26:10; pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., Actes 20:9.†

G2703.def:
κατα-φεύγω 
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;] 
to flee for refuge: before εἰς, Actes 14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Hébreux 6:18.†

G2704.def:
κατα-φθείρω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., Genèse 6:12, al. ;] 
__1 1 to destroy entirely. 
__2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, 2 Timothée 3:8.†

G2705.def:
κατα-φιλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָשַׁק ;] 
to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately: Matthieu 26:49, Marc 14:45, Luc 7:38, 45 15:20, Actes 20:37.†

G2706.def:
κατα-φρονέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בּוּז, etc. ;] 
to think little of, despise: with genitive, Matthieu 6:24 18:10, Luc 16:13, Romains 2:4, 1 Corinthiens 11:22, 1 Timothée 4:12 6:2, Hébreux 12:2, 2 Pierre 2:10.†

G2707.def:
κατα-φρονητής, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, Habacuc 1:5 2:5, Sophonie 3:4 * ;] 
a despiser: Actes 13:41.†

G2708.def:
κατα-χέω 
[in LXX for יָצַק, נָטָה, עָטָה hi. ;] 
to pour down upon: with genitive (cl.), Marc 14:3; before ἐπί, with genitive, Matthieu 26:7.†

G2709.def:
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον
(χθών, the earth), 
subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Philippiens 2:10.†

G2710.def:
κατα-χράομαι, -ῶμαι 
[in LXX: Ep. Je.28, 3Ma.4:5 3Mac 5:22 * ;] 
to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up: 1 Corinthiens 7:31; with dative, 1 Corinthiens 9:18 (for other senses, see LS, see word)..†

G2711.def:
κατα-ψύχω 
[in LXX: Genèse 18:4 (שָׁעַן ni.)* ;] 
to cool: with accusative, Luc 16:24.†

G2713.def:
κατέναντι 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים, Genèse 7:1, etc. ;] 
over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, Luc 19:30; as prep., with genitive, Matthieu 21:2 27:24 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), Marc 11:2 12:41 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) Marc 13:3; metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, Romains 4:17, 2 Corinthiens 2:17 12:19.†

G2714.def:
κατενώπιον 
adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: Psaumes 44:15, al. ;] 
over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Éphésiens 1:4, Colossiens 1:22.†

G2715.def:
κατ-εξουσιάζω 
to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 20:25, Marc 10:42.†
SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with)

G2716.def:
κατ-εργάζομαι
(emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different Heb. word) ;] 
to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, Romains 4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20, 2 Corinthiens 7:10, Éphésiens 6:13, Jacques 1:3; pass., 2 Corinthiens 12:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Romains 7:13, 2 Corinthiens 4:17 7:11 9:11; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), Romains 15:18; τ. σωτηρίαν, Philippiens 2:12; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 5:5 (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, Romains 1:27 2:9, 1 Corinthiens 5:3, 1 Pierre 4:3.†

G2718.def:
κατ-έρχομαι 
[in LXX: Tob.1:22, א Tob.2:1, Esther 3:13, Wis.11:22, 2Ma.11:29 * ;] 
to come down, go down: before εἰς, Luc 4:31, Actes 8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1, Τ; ἀπό, Luc 9:37, Actes 15:1 18:5 21:10; ἀπό and εἰς, Actes 11:27 12:10; of coming to port by ship, Actes 18:22 21:3 27:5; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Actes 9:32; metaphorically, of gifts from God, Jacques 3:15.†

G2719.def:
κατ-εσθίω
("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;] 
to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, Matthieu 13:4, Marc 4:4, Luc 8:5; τέκνον, Apocalypse 12:4; βιβλαρίδιον, Apocalypse 10:9-10; metaphorically, οἰκίας, Matthieu 23:13, Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47; τ. βίον, Luc 15:30; with accusative of person(s), Jean 2:17 (LXX), 2 Corinthiens 11:20, Galates 5:15, Apocalypse 11:5 20:9.†

G2720.def:
κατ-ευθύνω 
[in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;] 
to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:11; τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, Luc 1:79; τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:5.†

G2721.def:
κατ-εφ-ίστημι 
to rise up against: Actes 18:12.†

G2722.def:
κατ-έχω 
[in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;] 
__1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155), 
__(a) to possess, hold fast: Luc 8:15, Jean 5:4, Romains 1:18 (Lft., Notes, 251), 1 Corinthiens 7:30 11:2, 2 Corinthiens 6:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:21, Hébreux 3:6, 14 10:23; 
__(b) to lay hold of, get possession of: Luc 14:9. 
__2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., Luc 4:42; before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), 2 Thessaloniciens 2:6-7. 
__3. Intrans., as nautical term, to put in, make for (LS, see word): Actes 27:40.†

G2723.def:
κατηγορέω, -ῶ
(κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), 1Ma.7:6 1Mac 7:25, 2Ma.4:47 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:21, 4Ma.9:14 * ;] 
to make accusation, accuse, 
__(a) in general: absol., Romains 2:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), Jean 5:45; irreg. with accusative of person(s), Apocalypse 12:10; 
__(b) before a judge: absol., Actes 24:2, 19; with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 12:10, Marc 3:2, Luc 6:7 11:54 (WH, txt., R, om.), Luc 23:2, 10, Jean 8:6 Actes 25:5 28:19; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), Marc 15:3-4; with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), Actes 24:8 25:11; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), Actes 24:13; with accusative of thing(s), before κατά with genitive of person(s) (WM, § 28, 1), Luc 23:14. Pass. (B1., § 54, 3), before ὑπό with genitive, Matthieu 27:12, Actes 22:30; ὁ κατηγορούμενος, Actes 25:16.†

G2724.def:
κατηγορία, -ας, ἡ
(κατήγορος), 
an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), Jean 18:29; before κατά, with id., 1 Timothée 5:19; with genitive of thing(s), Tite 1:6.†

G2725.def:
κατήγορος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Proverbes 18:17 (רִיב), 2Ma.4:5 * ;] 
an accuser: Actes 23:30, 35 24:8 (WH, R, txt. om.) Actes 25:16, 18.†

G2726.def:
κατήφεια, -ας, ἡ
(κατηφής, downcast, Wis.17:4 *), 
dejection: Jacques 4:9.†

G2727.def:
κατ-ηχέω, -ῶ 
__1. to resound. 
__2. to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform (see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): Galates 6:6; with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 14:19; pass. with accusative of thing(s), Luc 1:4 (ICC, in l), Actes 18:25 21:24 (cf. Lk, l.with), Galates 6:6; before κ, with genitive of thing(s), Romains 2:18; περί, with genitive of person(s), Actes 21:21.†

G2728.def:
κατ-ιόω, -ῶ
(intensive of ἰόω; ἰός) [in LXX: Sir.12:11 * ;] 
to rust over; pass., become rusted over: Jacques 5:3.†

G2729.def:
κατ-ισχύω 
[in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;] 
to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., Luc 23:23; with inf., Luc 21:36; with genitive, Matthieu 16:18.†

G2730.def:
κατ-οικέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;] 
__1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Luc 13:4, Actes 1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Apocalypse 17:2; of God, Matthieu 23:21. 
__2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: Actes 22:12; before ἐν (cl.), Actes 1:20 (LXX) Actes 2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Hébreux 11:9, Apocalypse 13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Matthieu 2:23 4:13, Actes 7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Nombres 13:33, al.), Apocalypse 3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., Actes 17:26; ὅπου, Apocalypse 2:13; ἐκεῖ (of demons), Matthieu 12:45, Luc 11:26. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, Éphésiens 3:17; τ. πνεῦμα, Jacques 4:5 (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), Colossiens 1:19 2:9; δικαιοσύνη (cf. Wis.1:4), 2 Pierre 3:13 (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).†
κατοικίζω, 
[in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;] 
to cause to dwell: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, Jacques 4:5 (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).†

G2731.def:
κατ-οίκησις, -εως, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for יָשַׁב, Genèse 10:30, al. ;] 
dwelling: Marc 5:3.†

G2732.def:
κατ-οικητήριον, -ου, τό
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב, מָעוֹן, etc. ;] 
a habitation, dwelling-place: Éphésiens 2:22, Apocalypse 18:2.†

G2733.def:
κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, Exode 35:3, al. ;] 
__1. a dwelling: Actes 17:26. 
__2. a settlement (Polyb.).†

G2734.def:
κατοπτρίζω
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror), 
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2 Corinthiens 3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†

G2736.def:
κάτω 
adv. (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), Matthieu 4:6, Luc 4:9, Jean 8:6, 8, Actes 20:9. 
__2. below, beneath: Marc 14:66, Actes 2:19" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. (Eze.1:27, al.), Matthieu 27:51, Marc 15:38. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), Jean 8:23. Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. 1 Chroniques 27:21), Matthieu 2:16.†

G2737.def:
κατώτερος, -έρα, -ερον
(κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;] 
lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. Psaumes 139:15; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): Éphésiens 4:9.†

G2738.def:
καῦμα, -τος, τό
(καίω), [in LXX for חֹם, חֹרֶב, etc. ;] 
heat: Apocalypse 7:16 16:9.†

G2739.def:
καυματίζω
(καῦμα), 
to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Apocalypse 16:8. Pass., Matthieu 13:14, Marc 4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Apocalypse 16:9.†

G2740.def:
καῦσις, -εως, ἡ
(καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;] 
burning: Hébreux 6:8.†

G2741.def:
καυσόω, -ῶ
(καῦσος, burning heat, fever), 
only in pass., 
__1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.). 
__2. In NT, to burn with great heat: 2 Pierre 3:10 3:12 (V. Mayor, in l).†

G2742.def:
καύσων, -ωνος, ὁ
(καίω), [in LXX: Genèse 31:40 א (חֹרֶב), Ésaïe 49:10 (שָׁרָב), Job 27:21, Osée 12:1, (2), Osée 13:15, Jonas 4:8, Jérémie 18:17, Eze.17:10 19:12 (קָדִים); Jérémie 51:1, From Theodotion Daniel 3:67) Jdth.8:3, Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22 * ;] 
__1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): Matthieu 20:12, Luc 12:55 (Jacques 1:11, AV). 
__2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on Amos 4:9): Jacques 1:11 (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†

G2743.def:
καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word) 
to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1 Timothée 4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†

G2744.def:
καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι 
[in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;] 
to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on Jacques 1:9): absol., 1 Corinthiens 1:31 (LXX) 1 Corinthiens 4:7 13:3, 2 Corinthiens 10:13 10:17" (LXX) 2 Corinthiens 11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6, Éphésiens 2:9, Jacques 4:16; with accusative of thing(s), 2 Corinthiens 9:2 11:30; before ἐν (LXX), Romains 2:23 5:3, 1 Corinthiens 3:21, 2 Corinthiens 5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9, Galates 6:13-14 Jacques 1:9; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, Romains 2:17 5:11; ἐν κυρίῳ, 1 Corinthiens 1:31 (LXX) 2 Corinthiens 10:17 (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, Philippiens 3:3; before ἐπί with dative, Romains 5:2; περί, with genitive, 2 Corinthiens 10:8; εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 10:16; ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 7:14 12:5; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1 Corinthiens 1:29 (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).†

G2745.def:
καύχημα, -τος, τό
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;] 
__1. a boast (Pind.): 2 Corinthiens 5:12 9:3 (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on Galates 6:4; Lft., Notes, 204, 277). 
__2. ground or matter of glorying: Romains 4:2, 1 Corinthiens 5:6 9:15-16, 2 Corinthiens 1:14, Galates 6:4, Philippiens 1:26 2:16, Hébreux 3:6 (cf. καύχησις).†

G2746.def:
καύχησις, -εως, ἡ
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה (1 Chroniques 29:13, Eze.16:12, al) ;] 
a boasting, glorying: Romains 3:27, 2 Corinthiens 11:10 11:17, Jacques 4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2 Corinthiens 7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2 Corinthiens 7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Romains 15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1 Thessaloniciens 2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2 Corinthiens 1:12.†

G2747.def:
Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ, 
Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: Actes 18:18, Romains 16:1.†

G2748.def:
κέδρος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, Nombres 24:6, al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, 2 Rois 15:23, 3Ki.15:13 (קִדְרוֹן) ;] 
a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), Jean 18:1 (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).†
Κεδρών 
(see: κέδρος), ὁ, 
indecl. 
(in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: 2 Rois 15:23, 4Ki.23:6, al. ;] 
Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., Jean 18:1 (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).†

G2750.def:
κειρία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX: Proverbes 7:16 (מַרְבַד)* ;] 
a vernacular word, 
__1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with). 
__2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): Jean 11:44.†

G2751.def:
κείρω 
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, Ésaïe 53:7, al. ;] 
to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, Actes 8:32 (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., 1 Corinthiens 11:6; τ-. κεφαλήν, Actes 18:18.†

G2752.def:
κέλευσμα, -τος, τό
(κελεύω), [in LXX: Proverbes 30:27 * ;] 
a call, summons, shout of command: 1 Thessaloniciens 4:16 (see M, Th., in l).†

G2753.def:
κελεύω 
[in LXX: I Esther 9:53, Tob.8:18, al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;] 
to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., Matthieu 14:19, 28 18:25 27:64, Luc 18:40, Actes 4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17; with ellipse of accusative, Matthieu 8:18 14:9 27:58, Actes 12:19 21:33; with accusative and inf. Pres., Actes 21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43; with ellipse of accusative, Actes 16:22; ptcp. aor., Actes 25:23.†
SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω

G2754.def:
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;] 
__1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with). 
__2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Philippiens 2:3.†

G2756.def:
κενός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;] 
empty (Genèse 37:24, Juges 7:16). Metaphorical, 
__(a) empty, vain: λόγοι, Éphésiens 5:6; ἀπάτη, Colossiens 2:8; κήρυγμα, πίστις, 1 Corinthiens 15:14; 
__(b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, 1 Corinthiens 15:10; κόπος, 1 Corinthiens 15:50; ἡ εἴσοδος, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:1; κενά, Actes 4:25 (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), 2 Corinthiens 6:1, Galates 2:2, Philippiens 2:16, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:5; 
__(with) of persons, empty-handed: Marc 12:3, Luc 1:53 20:10-11; vain, Jacques 2:20.†
SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., Syn., xlix)

G2757.def:
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), Ésaïe 8:19 * ;] 
empty talk, babbling: pl., 1 Timothée 6:20, 2 Timothée 2:16.†

G2758.def:
κενόω, -ῶ 
(κενός, which see), [in LXX: Jérémie 14:2 15:9 (עָמָל pu.)* ;] 
to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, 1 Corinthiens 9:15; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, Philippiens 2:7 (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, Romains 4:14; ὁ σταυρός, 1 Corinthiens 1:17; καύχημα, 2 Corinthiens 9:3†

G2759.def:
κέντρον, -ου, τό
(εκντέω, to prick), [in LXX: Proverbes 26:3 (מֶתֶג), Osée 13:14 (קֹטֶב), Osée 5:12, Sir.38:25, 4Ma.14:19 * ;] 
__1. a sting (4Mac, l.with): Apocalypse 9:10. Metaphorical (as Osée 13:14): τ. θανάτου, 1 Corinthiens 15:55 (LXX), 1 Corinthiens 15:56, 
__2. a goad: pl., Actes 26:14.†

G2760.def:
κεντυρίων, -ωνος, ὁ (Lat. centurio); 
a centurion: Marc 15:39, 44-45 (Mt, Lk, use ἑκιτόνταρχος (-ης), q.v).†

G2761.def:
κενῶς 
adv., [in LXX: Ésaïe 49:4 (רִיק)* ;] 
in vain, to no purpose: Jacques 4:5.†

G2762.def:
κεραία (WH, κερέα, see App., 151), -ας, ἠ 
(κέρας), 
a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), Matthieu 5:18, Luc 16:17.†

G2763G.def:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Psaumes 2:9, Jérémie 18:2, al. ;] 
a potter: Romains 9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Matthieu 27:7, (LXX).†

G2763H.def:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Psaumes 2:9, Jérémie 18:2, al. ;] 
a potter: Romains 9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Matthieu 27:7, (LXX).†

G2764.def:
κεραμικός, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;] 
__1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ). 
__2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Apocalypse 2:27.†

G2765.def:
κεράμιον, -ου, τό
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Jérémie 35:5 (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;] 
an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, Marc 14:13, Luc 22:10.†

G2766.def:
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: 2 Rois 17:28 (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;] 
__1. potter's clay. 
__2. an earthen vessel. 
__3. a tile: Luc 5:19.†

G2767.def:
κεράννυμι 
[in LXX for מָסַךְ, Ésaïe 5:22, al. ;] 
to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: Apocalypse 18:6; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, Apocalypse 14:10.†
SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις)

G2768.def:
κέρας, -ατος
(pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן ;] 
a horn: Apocalypse 5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16; of the projections at the corners of the altar (Exode 29:12, al.): Apocalypse 9:13. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. Psaumes 18:3, al.): Luc 1:69.†

G2769.def:
κεράτιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κέρας), 
__1. a little horn (Arist.). 
__2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: Luc 15:16.†

G2770.def:
κερδαίνω 
[in Sm.: Job 22:3 * ;] 
to gain: with accusative, Matthieu 25:16-17, 20 25:22; τ. κόσμον, Matthieu 16:26, Marc 8:36, Luc 9:25; absol., to make profit, get gain: Jacques 4:13. Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), to save oneself from, avoid: Actes 27:21 (Field, Notes, 145); with accusative of person(s), to gain, win: Matthieu 18:15, 1 Corinthiens 9:19-22, Philippiens 3:8; pass., 1 Pierre 3:1.†

G2771.def:
κέρδος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in Aq.: Eze.27:24; Sm.: Psaumes 30:10, al. ;] 
gain: Philippiens 1:21 3:7, Tite 1:11.†

G2772.def:
κέρμα, -τος, τό
(κείρω), 
__1. a slice, hence, 
__2. a small coin: pl., Jean 2:15.†

G2773.def:
κερματιατής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money), 
a money changer: Jean 2:14.†

G2774.def:
κεφάλαιος, -α, -ον
(κεφαλή), [in LXX (-αιον, τό) for רֹאשׁ, Num_4:2, al. ;] 
of the head; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό; 
__1. the chief point: Hébreux 8:1. 
__2. the sum total, amount: Actes 22:28 (other meaning, LS, see word).†

G2775.def:
κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: Sir.32:8 *]), -ῶ 
(κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers) 
__1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.). 
__2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: Marc 12:4.†

G2776.def:
κεφαλή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;] 
the head: Matthieu 5:35, Marc 6:24, Apocalypse 1:14 9:7, al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., Romains 12:20 (LXX); αἷμι, Actes 18:6; metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, 1 Corinthiens 1:13, Éphésiens 5:23; of Christ, 1 Corinthiens 11:3, Éphésiens 4:15 5:23, Colossiens 1:18 2:10, 19; of things, κ. γωνίας, Matthieu 21:42 (LXX)

G2777.def:
κεφαλίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dimin. of κεφαλή), [in LXX for מְגִלָּה, וָו, etc. ;] 
__1. a little head. 
__2. an extremity, capital (of a column). 
__3. (As in Exode 2:9, Psaumes 40:8, Esther 6:2) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, Hébreux 10:7 (LXX).†

G2778.def:
κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census), 
a poll-tax: Matthieu 17:25 22:17, Marc 12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Matthieu 22:19 (see MM, Exp., xv).†

G2779.def:
κῆπος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for גַּן, גַּנָּה, גִּנָּה, Deutéronome 11:10, Cantique des cantiques 4:12, al. ;] 
a garden: Luc 13:19, Jean 18:1, 26 19:41.†

G2780.def:
κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher) 
a gardener: Jean 20:15.†

G2781.def:
κηρίον, -ου, τό
(κηρός, wax), [in LXX for נֹפֶת, צוּף, Psaumes 19:10 118:12, Proverbes 16:24, al. ;] 
honeycomb: κ. μελίσσιον, Luc 24:42 (Rec.; WH, txt., R, txt., omit).†

G2782.def:
κήρυγμα, -τος, τό
(κηρύσσω), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 30:5 (קוֹל), Jonas 3:2 (קְרִיאָה), Proverbes 9:3, I Esther 9:3 * ;] 
in cl., 
that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Matthieu 12:41, Luc 11:32, 1 Corinthiens 1:21, 2 Timothée 4:17, Tite 1:3; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, 1 Corinthiens 2:4; ἡμῶν, 1 Corinthiens 15:14; with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Romains 16:25.†

G2783.def:
κῆρυξ
(κήρ-, T), -υκος, ὁ [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:4 (כָּרוֹז), Genèse 41:43, Sir.20:15, 4Ma.6:4 * ;] 
a herald: 1 Timothée 2:7, 2 Timothée 1:11, 2 Pierre 2:5.†

G2784.def:
κηρύσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
to be a herald, to proclaim: Marc 1:45 7:36, Luc 4:18-19" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) Luc 8:39, Romains 2:21, 1 Corinthiens 9:27, Galates 5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Matthieu 4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13, Marc 1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15, Galates 2:2, Colossiens 1:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9; before εἰς, Marc 1:39 13:10, Luc 4:44, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9; ἵνα, Marc 6:12; with inf.. Romains 2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, Actes 8:5 9:20 19:13, 1 Corinthiens 1:23 15:12, 2 Corinthiens 1:19 11:4, Philippiens 1:15; 1 Timothée 3:16 (cf. προ-κηρύσσω)

G2785.def:
κῆτος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX: Jonas 2:1; Jonas 2:10 (דָּג) Genèse 1:21 (תַּנִּין), etc. ;] 
a huge fish, sea-monster: Matthieu 12:40 (LXX).†

G2786.def:
Κηφᾶς, -ᾶ (see Bl., § 10, 3), ὁ (Aram. כֵּיפָא), 
Cephas, i.e. Peter: Jean 1:43, 1 Corinthiens 1:12 3:22 9:5 15:5, Galates 1:18 2:9, 11 2:14.†

G2787G.def:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ 
[in LXX: Genèse 6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Exode 25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;] 
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Matthieu 24:38, Luc 17:27, Hébreux 11:7, 1 Pierre 3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Hébreux 9:4, Apocalypse 11:19.†

G2787H.def:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ 
[in LXX: Genèse 6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Exode 25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;] 
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Matthieu 24:38, Luc 17:27, Hébreux 11:7, 1 Pierre 3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Hébreux 9:4, Apocalypse 11:19.†

G2788.def:
κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in Psaumes 33:2, al.); and in (Daniel 3:5, al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;] 
a lyre, harp: 1 Corinthiens 14:7, Apocalypse 5:8 14:2 15:2.†

G2789.def:
κιθαρίζω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 23:16 (נָגַן pi.)* ;] 
to play upon the lyre or harp: 1 Corinthiens 14:7, Apocalypse 14:2.†

G2790.def:
κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer) 
one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: Apocalypse 14:2 18:22.†

G2791.def:
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ 
Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: Actes 6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5, Galates 1:21.†

G2792.def:
κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό 
(from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן) 
cinnamon: Apocalypse 18:13.†

G2793.def:
κινδυνεύω
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to be daring, to venture. 
__2. to be in danger: Luc 8:23, Actes 19:27, 40, 1 Corinthiens 15:30.†

G2794.def:
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Psaumes 116:3 (מֵצַר), Sir.3:26, al. ;] 
danger, peril: Romains 8:35; pl., 2 Corinthiens 11:26.†

G2795.def:
κινέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;] 
__1. to set in motion, move: Matthieu 23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Psaumes 22:8, al.), Matthieu 27:39, Marc 15:29; pass. (cf. Genèse 7:21), Actes 17:28. 
__2. to remove: Apocalypse 2:5 6:14. 
__3. to excite, stir up: Actes 24:5; pass., Actes 21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†

G2796.def:
κίνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κινέω), [in LXX: Job 16:6 (5), (נִיד), al. ;] 
a moving: Jean 5:3.†

G2797.def:
Κείς (Rec. Κίς), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. קִישׁ), 
Kish: Actes 13:21.†

G2798.def:
κλάδος, -ου, ὁ
(κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;] 
a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: Matthieu 13:32 21:8 24:32, Marc 4:32 13:28, Luc 13:19; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), Romains 11:16-19, 21.†
